name: Credit Applications
business_definition: Count of credit applications submitted

name: Credit Approval Rate (Certified)
business_definition: Share of applications receiving final credit approval after KYC and affordability

name: Credit Approval Rate (Credit-local)
business_definition: Share of applications approved by Credit decision engine before final KYC gates
where_used: Conflict view only — not for exec

name: Booking Rate
business_definition: Share of certified-approved applications that are disbursed/booked on CBS

name: Disbursed Amount (AED)
business_definition: Sum of principal disbursed on booking date

name: Portfolio Outstanding (AED)
business_definition: Sum of outstanding principal on active loans (CBS system of record)

name: FPD Rate
business_definition: First-payment-default amount as % of first instalment due

name: DPD30 Rate
business_definition: Outstanding in DPD≥30 as % of portfolio outstanding (amount-weighted)

name: Recognised Revenue (AED)
business_definition: Revenue recognised under Finance policy (fees + profit accrued in period)

name: Product-Reported Revenue (AED)
business_definition: Product's broader revenue view including deferred/projected items

name: Savings AUM (AED)
business_definition: Total savings balances on CBS/savings ledger

name: New Savings Accounts
business_definition: Count of savings accounts opened

name: Active Customers (Certified)
business_definition: Customers with ≥1 open product relationship (loan OR savings OR card), KYC complete, not fraud-blocked

name: Active Customers (Product 30d login)
business_definition: Customers with app login in last 30 days

name: Active Customers (Finance 90d txn)
business_definition: Customers with revenue-recognised txn in last 90 days

name: Active Customers (Credit open loan)
business_definition: Customers with open loan on CBS

name: Payment Success Rate
business_definition: Successful payment captures / payment attempts (excl. test)

name: Payment Attempts
business_definition: Count of customer payment attempts

name: CBS ↔ Warehouse Recon Break Rate
business_definition: Share of critical loan/balance keys failing OMS/CBS vs warehouse checks

name: Avg Ticket Size (AED)
business_definition: Average disbursed amount per booked loan
